subject: Annual prepay invoicing cadence, ops checklist & multi-currency remit
messages:

Subject: Annual prepay — invoice cadence questions and remit details

Hi Priyom,

We're finalizing our internal forecast for the annual prepay and want to confirm a few operational items before signing the SOW:

- Invoice cadence: we plan to trigger an initial 50% prepayment at contract activation, then 3 staggered releases tied to usage milestones. Can Redwood issue a single consolidated invoice per tranche (one PDF) or do you require multiple line-item invoices by region?
- Bank mapping: we need an explicit remit matrix for USD/EUR/GBP rails (bank account, beneficiary name, SWIFT/IBAN) so our treasury can configure wires.
- VAT handling: Brightlane is VAT-registered in the EU. Please confirm whether Redwood will issue VAT on our invoices or if reverse-charge is required (we can provide VAT IDs).

If you can send a short checklist and sample invoice template, procurement can loop in our AP team. We also need an expected DocuSign envelope and the HubSpot deal id for our records.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Park
Head of Finance — Brightlane Technologies
finance@brightlane.com

Subject: Re: Annual prepay — invoice cadence questions and remit details

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear list. Putting ops answers below and attaching a short ops checklist + sample invoice PDF and bank mapping CSV for treasury.

TL;DR: We can issue one consolidated invoice per tranche (single PDF) with line-item breakdowns per region, and we support reverse-charge for EU customers when you provide VAT IDs. Wire remits will be by currency as per the attached CSV.

Operational details:
- Invoice cadence & format: Redwood will issue one invoice per agreed tranche. Each invoice PDF will contain a summary page and a breakdown by model/route so your internal cost centers can map spend. If you need separate invoices per legal entity/country, let me know — that requires a separate billing entity in the contract.
- Tranche triggers: We'll mark tranche 1 as 'Activation (50%)' and subsequent tranches as 'Usage triggers' with the thresholds we discussed in the SOW. Kimberly, can you confirm the default invoice-only window (e.g., invoice generated within 3 business days of tranche trigger)?
- Bank mapping: attached redwood-bank-mapping-CSV.csv — includes currency, account name, account number, SWIFT/IBAN, and remittance reference to include. If treasury requires a beneficiary proof PDF, we can provide it.
- VAT: We will not charge VAT on B2B EU invoices if you supply a valid VAT ID and select the reverse-charge option. Please send your Brightlane VAT IDs and country registration.
- DocuSign & HubSpot: Deal HS-49321 will be the envelope reference; DocuSign link will be sent once finance countersigns.

Attachments included: 2026-06-13-Redwood-sample-invoice.pdf, redwood-bank-mapping-CSV.csv, Brightlane-KYC-template.pdf

Next steps / asks for Brightlane:
1) Confirm the tranche definition in the SOW (we'll mirror exact wording on invoices).
2) Send VAT IDs and preferred remit currency per legal entity.
3) Complete KYC template (attached) and return to kimberly_park@redwood.com for payments onboarding.

Thanks — looping Kimberly and Marissa to own onboarding and collection ops.

Best,
Priyom Das
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.com

Attachments: 2026-06-13-Redwood-sample-invoice.pdf (sample invoice stub), redwood-bank-mapping-CSV.csv (bank mapping stub), Brightlane-KYC-template.pdf (KYC template stub)
From: kimberly_park@redwood.com <kimberly_park@redwood.com>

Date: Sun, 14 Jun 2026 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Annual prepay — invoice cadence questions and remit details

Hi all — ops notes and timeline from billing + treasury: 

1) Invoice generation SLA: We generate the tranche invoice within 2 business days of the trigger (pdf + accounting CSV export). If Brightlane needs additional line-level metadata (cost center, project codes), we can inject those fields if provided before activation.

2) Remittance & reconciliation:
- Treasury prefers a unique string in the 'Payment Reference' field that includes Deal HS-49321 and tranche number (e.g., HS-49321-T1). That speeds reconciliation.
- For EUR payments into our EU entity, use the EUR IBAN row from the attached CSV; for GBP and USD likewise. Please confirm which legal entity will pay each tranche (Brightlane US vs Brightlane EU) so we can tag invoices correctly for VAT.

3) KYC and bank setup:
- Once Brightlane returns the KYC PDF we will provision the bank-receive accounts in our payments system; this typically takes 3-5 business days.
- If Brightlane elects to pay via ACH vs wire for USD, note ACH clears in 1-2 days; wire is same-day but incurs bank fees. State preference in the KYC return.

4) FX and ledger posting:
- We will post invoices in the invoiced currency and provide a USD-converted ledger for your internal burn reports. If you want netting across currencies, raise it now — rollout to ledger requires a one-time mapping.

Questions for Brightlane:
- Which entity signs the SOW (legal name as it should appear on invoice)?
- Confirm VAT IDs and whether reverse-charge applies for EU tranches.
- Preferred payment rails per tranche (wire/ACH/SEPA/GBP-CHAPS).

Marissa — once we have the KYC and entity confirmation, please queue the onboarding and send the DocuSign envelope with HS-49321 in the subject.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Billing & Payments | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

Ask: could Redwood add an extra line on the invoice right below the header with a short human-readable description of the tranche trigger (e.g., "Activation — 50% prepay for contract start")? That helps our AP when coding payments.

Elena / team — thanks for the confirmations. Final checklist and acceptance criteria below so billing can close out onboarding this week.

Acceptance checklist (what Redwood needs back from Brightlane):
1) Signed SOW indicating Brightlane Technologies, Inc. as signer and mention of Brightlane GmbH for EU tranches (DocuSign envelope will carry HS-49321).
2) Completed Brightlane-KYC-template.pdf with preferred payment rails per tranche (ACH/SEPA) and bank contact.
3) VAT IDs for EU entity and confirmation you want reverse-charge applied.
4) Treasury confirmation of payment reference format (we recommend HS-49321-T#).

Internal Redwood actions on receipt (timeline):
- Day 0–2 after KYC & signed SOW: Provision accounts and enable remit rails.
- Day 2–4: Generate DocuSign envelope for countersign; finance will queue tranche invoice generation.
- Day 3–5: For first wire/ACH, expect reconciliation email from marissa_cole with ledger and remittance guidance.

We will include the short human-readable tranche descriptor you requested under the invoice header. That will appear as 'Invoice Note' and be populated from the SOW tranche name.

If all good, please return the KYC and signed SOW and we will mark the deal as 'Ready for Billing' in HubSpot HS-49321.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this out.

Best,
